name: LocalAssistant
description: Blinds, heat pumps, radiators, cameras and energy on one page : Tuya blinds over the LAN, Mitsubishi heat pumps, Zigbee2MQTT, Shelly and Linky meters, routines, and AI apps over MCP. Talks to devices on your network directly, so deploy it on a node in the same LAN. The first visit asks for the setup code printed in the logs.
